summary: Closed a strictly comparable 30-minute pre/post Pages-build measurement around Agent Runtime repair run 36654277851. Pre: 210 total, 209 cancelled, 1 success; post: 217 total, 213 cancelled, 4 success. Cancellation rate moved from 99.524% to 98.157% (-1.367 percentage points). All 427 included runs are terminal; 44 transition-gap Pages runs are explicitly excluded. Narrow redundant Agent Runtime writer suppression remains proven, while total Pages churn remains severe and the aggregate delta is not attributed causally to that repair.
